intent: Design the first run, when there is no data and no habit yet.
moves: Make the empty state the teacher: say what goes here and give the action that starts it.
Show one path to first value, not a tour of every feature.
Prefill or sample data where it removes a blank-page decision.
Ask for nothing at signup that the product does not need to work.
Make the first success visible and immediate, so the second use has a reason.
avoid: A modal tour that must be dismissed before anything can be tried.
Empty states that describe the emptiness without offering the next step.
Progress meters toward a goal the user has not agreed to.
